# AgentTool client boundary

[Module map](../README.md) · [Source directory](../../../packages/substrate-client)

Provide a server-only, lazily configured client for the external AgentTool substrate.

**Scope:** Optional external adapter; absent credentials must produce an honest degraded state, and credentials do not grant cross-project authority.

**Placement:** pnpm workspace member; package `@cambridge-tcg/substrate-client`.

## Progress

Source review recorded **2026-09-28**. Client/status helpers and configuration guidance are present. Package declaration alone does not establish active consumers or a working external connection.

This records source and documentation evidence. It does not establish deployment, external access, service health, or passing tests.

**Next review:** Inspect actual imports and intended scope before wiring a consumer; keep external calls and server credentials outside public bundles.
